def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().replace({'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].apply(lambda x: x/1000 if x > 6500 else x)
    return df

def answer(df):
    counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return counts
